program_name: Ang Edukasyon at Gabay Pangkabuhayan para sa Siyudad ng Imus 2.0
location: Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP)
description:
The Cavite State University (CvSU) launched a seminar entitled “Ang Edukasyon at Gabay Pangkabuhayan para sa Siyudad ng Imus 2.0” held on January 31 at the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP).

The CvSU Imus Campus Extension Services and Unit collaborated with other departments to equip Persons Deprived of Liberty (PDL) with proper education and livelihood skills to improve inside the community.

Photos by Angela Meiko Malate, Photojournalist

program_name: CVSU CARES: HELPING HANDS FOR THE VICTIMS OF TROPICAL STORM KRISTINE
description: Cavite State University-Imus Campus community came together to help the typhoon victims in Barangay San Antonio II, Noveleta, Cavite. The relief effort was made possible through the collaboration of various campus units, including CvSU Heroes Aiding Response Team (CHART), Research Development and Extension Office (RDE), Gender and Development Office (GAD), and Student Development and Services (SDS). Together, they organized donation drives, collected essential items such as food, water, and clothing, and prepared the donations for delivery. These items have now been handed over to the barangay captain, Kap. Joselito Uylengco for distribution to the affected families. This collective effort highlights our commitment to helping communities in need.

department: Department of Languages and Mass Communication
description:
The Department of Social Sciences and Humanities, together with the Department of Languages and Mass Communication and the Teacher Education Department- CVSU Imus will be conducting an extension service to PDLs (Persons Deprived of Liberty) in the BJMP Imus intending to address their needs, and hope that we can give them a chance to feel the true spirit of the season by allowing them to enjoy the love and generosity from others.

If you want to be an instrument of change in the lives of our fellow PDLs, you may extend a helping hand by donating either monetary or non-cash gifts.

program_name: Jail Officers from the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) of Region 4-A holds an assembly at the CvSU-Imus conference room
description:
Jail Officers from the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) of Region 4-A holds an assembly at the CvSU-Imus conference room in partnership with CvSU Research Extension Services, earlier.

BJMP Officers are present to discuss and invite anyone to make an application as a Jail Officer. In addition to discussing history, mission, and vision, the BJMP also shared their mandated major and core programs for Person Deprived of Liberty (PDL).
In attendance are university administrators and student leaders from various organizations.

Interested applicants are advised to visit the BJMP Facebook page for more information.

Via Angela Advincula | Business and Circulation Manager
Photos by Gabriel Louiz A Paredes | Editor-in-Chief

program_name: Maintaining Honesty and Integrity in Public Service
description:
To promote awareness to various events proclaimed by the Philippine Government, Extension Services (ES) in partnership with the College of Arts and Sciences (CAS) being the lead college, College of Economics and Development Studies (CEMDS), CvSU-CCAT Campus and CvSU - Imus Campus will be holding a webinar under ISTORYA (Impactful Services and Transformative Opportunities in Response to the needs of the CommunitY and the Academe).

This webinar episode 3 titled " Maintaining Honesty and Integrity in Public Service" is in support to the approved Proclamation No. 591, s. 2004 or the Anti-Graft and Corruption Awareness Month. Learn from our Resource Speaker, MR. GRECO ANTONIOUS BEDA B. BELGICA, the Chairman of Presidential Anti-Corruption Commission.

project_titles: ["Empowering Minds through Instruction, Research, and Extension: Faculty and Staff (Re) Orientation for Impactful Service"]
department: Department of Social Sciences and Humanities
description:
The Cavite State University – Imus Campus successfully conducted its Faculty and Staff (Re) Orientation with the theme “Empowering Minds through Instruction, Research, and Extension: Faculty and Staff (Re) Orientation for Impactful Service” on September 3, 2025, 7:00 AM at the Covered Court, CvSU Imus Campus.

The activity, organized by the Campus Human Resource Development Office and the Campus Administrator, Dr. Armi Grace B. Desingaño, aimed to align faculty and staff with the university’s vision, mission, goals, and policies while reinforcing their commitment to impactful service in instruction, research, and extension. It also provided updates on strategic plans, workplace standards, and student services to ensure unified action in delivering quality education.

The whole-day program featured sessions on CvSU’s vision and strategic plan, gender and development initiatives, workplace standards and decorum, research and extension catch-up plans, and campus services such as OSAS, Registrar, HR, and Accounting. Department heads and coordinators also presented updates on semestral requirements, followed by an open forum and closing program.

Through this re-orientation, CvSU Imus strengthened collaboration among its officials, faculty, and staff in sustaining excellence in service, guided by its core values of Truth, Integrity, Excellence, and Service.

description:
Our Psychology students proudly participated in the Mental Health and Psychology Summit held on October 10, 2025, at the International Convention Center of Cavite State University – Main Campus, Indang, Cavite.

The summit served as a meaningful platform for learning and advocacy, highlighting the importance of mental health awareness and professional growth in the field of psychology. With inspiring discussions led by experts including Dr. Gina Hechanova-Alampay on “𝐄𝐧𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐌𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐥 𝐇𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐭𝐡 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐡: 𝐊𝐚𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐧 𝐏𝐥𝐮𝐬”, our students gained valuable insights that will strengthen their role as future mental health advocates and professionals.

description:
The Cavite State University (CvSU) Extension Services Center and Research Center, in collaboration with CvSU Bacoor City Campus, spearheaded a university-wide training titled “Strengthening Research and Extension Systems through Strategic Alignment, Compliance, and Collaboration.” The activity was held on October 21, 2025, at the Audio-Visual Room, College of Education, Cavite State University, Indang, Cavite.

The event aimed to enhance the understanding of faculty members and extension coordinators on aligning research and extension programs with institutional, regional, and national development priorities. It also emphasized the importance of compliance with university standards and the need for inter-campus collaboration in implementing impactful projects.

Representing Cavite State University – Imus Campus were 𝗗𝗿. 𝗔𝗿𝗺𝗶 𝗚𝗿𝗮𝗰𝗲 𝗕. 𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗴𝗮ñ𝗼, 𝗗𝗿. 𝗟𝗶𝗮𝗻𝗲 𝗩𝗶𝗻𝗮 𝗚. 𝗢𝗰𝗮𝗺𝗽𝗼, 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗗𝗿. 𝗘𝗹𝘃𝗶𝗿𝗮 𝗣𝗮𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴𝗮𝗻. Their participation demonstrated CvSU Imus’ continued commitment to promoting synergy between research and extension functions to foster innovation and sustainable community engagement.

Through this initiative, CvSU continues to strengthen its research and extension linkages ensuring that academic efforts contribute to inclusive growth and meaningful societal transformation.

description:
The Cavite State University (CvSU) Extension Services Center and Research Center conducted a workshop titled “Innovate to Impact: Translating Research Results Into Extension Proposals” on October 23, 2025, at the Technology Demonstration Farm Training Hall, Cavite State University, Indang, Cavite.

The event aimed to strengthen the capacity of faculty members and researchers in developing extension proposals derived from completed research outputs. It served as a venue to promote collaboration and ensure that research results are transformed into practical, community-based programs that contribute to sustainable development.
Representing Cavite State University – Imus Campus were 𝗗𝗿. 𝗟𝗶𝗮𝗻𝗲 𝗩𝗶𝗻𝗮 𝗚. 𝗢𝗰𝗮𝗺𝗽𝗼, 𝗗𝗿. 𝗟𝘂𝗶𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗮 𝗠𝗮𝗿𝘇𝗮𝗻, 𝗠𝘀. 𝗠𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗴𝗿𝗼𝘀 𝗩𝗶𝗮𝗱𝗼, 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗠𝗿. 𝗝𝗼𝗵𝗻 𝗝𝗼𝘀𝗲𝗽𝗵 𝗩𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗮. Their participation highlighted the campus’s continued commitment to integrating research and extension functions to address local and regional needs.

This initiative underscores CvSU’s ongoing thrust to translate innovation into social impact bridging academic research with meaningful community engagement and development.
